_petunjuk: jenis: 'salah' = LLM keliru (dihitung sebagai kesalahan di akurasi); 'standardisasi' = isi benar tetapi dilabeli ulang (Not reported / Partial / N/A). verified_ok = kolom yang sudah kalian cek ke PDF dan ternyata benar. Isi verified_ok hanya untuk paper di validated_papers, dan cek SEMUA 12 kolom agar akurasi valid.

catatan_paper.P05: Terjemahan mesin Inggris-Hindi lintas lima domain (kesehatan salah satunya). Bukan sistem klinis; dipakai sebagai pembanding RAG lintas domain.
catatan_paper.P07: Kerangka konseptual tanpa implementasi atau evaluasi empiris; angka kinerja bersifat hipotetis.
catatan_paper.P08: Chatbot klaim asuransi dan layanan pelanggan. Kesehatan hanya disebut sebagai domain lanjutan. Bukan sistem klinis.

evaluasi_faithfulness.value: Not reported (only discusses hallucination mitigation and future monitoring; no measurement of hallucination or faithfulness).
evaluasi_faithfulness.alasan: Definisi operasional: hanya klaim mitigasi tanpa pengukuran dihitung Not reported.

generator_llm.value: GPT-3.5 and Llama 2 70B (pilot study on cancer progression extraction). GPT-4 is only mentioned as an example of state-of-the-art LLMs.
generator_llm.alasan: Paper menyatakan hanya menguji GPT-3.5 dan Llama 2 70B; GPT-4 hanya contoh.

strategi_chunking.value: N/A - retrieves whole MIMIC-CXR training reports through image-label vector similarity; no text chunking is used.
strategi_chunking.alasan: Retrieval berbasis vektor label citra, bukan pemotongan teks.

evaluasi_faithfulness.value: Partial - clinical correctness (CheXbert, RadGraph) and linguistic metrics against reference reports, plus comparison with a no-retrieval baseline; no measure of grounding in retrieved reports and no hallucination rate.
evaluasi_faithfulness.alasan: Metrik berbasis laporan referensi, bukan kesesuaian dengan bukti yang diambil.

keterbatasan.value: Not reported (the paper has no limitations statement; the Conclusion only summarizes findings).
keterbatasan.alasan: LLM memasukkan temuan eksperimen sebagai keterbatasan.

evaluasi_faithfulness.value: Partial - BERT Similarity against reference translations and a qualitative comparison of hallucinated outputs (Table 6); no quantitative hallucination rate.
evaluasi_faithfulness.alasan: Hanya metrik kemiripan referensi dan contoh kualitatif.

hasil_utama.value: RAG with BLOOMZ-3B outperforms BLOOMZ-3B zero-shot in semantic similarity and hallucination, but zero-shot Airavata scores higher than the proposed RAG on CHRF++ and METEOR in all five domains (Table 4).
hasil_utama.alasan: LLM menyamaratakan klaim paper; Tabel 4 tidak mendukung keunggulan RAG terhadap semua baseline.

evaluasi_faithfulness.value: Partial - only reference-similarity metrics (METEOR, cosine similarity) against guideline-based reference texts; no measure of grounding in the retrieved context.
evaluasi_faithfulness.alasan: Tidak ada pengukuran kesesuaian jawaban dengan konteks hasil retrieval.

retriever_embedding.value: Proposed only (not implemented): OpenAI text-embedding-ada-002 or Sentence-BERT all-MiniLM-L6-v2 with a FAISS Flat/IVFFlat index.

generator_llm.value: Proposed only (not implemented): any LLM via API, with GPT-4 or Llama 2 given as examples.
generator_llm.alasan: Paper konseptual, tidak ada LLM yang benar-benar dijalankan.

metrik_evaluasi.value: No empirical evaluation. Only a hypothetical illustration: simulated cosine similarity (e.g. 0.79) and assumed time savings (5 minutes versus 30-45 minutes manual).
metrik_evaluasi.alasan: Paper menyatakan metrik dan keluaran bersifat hipotetis.

evaluasi_faithfulness.value: Not reported (conceptual paper: only proposes mitigations such as factual scoring, iterative RAG and citation alignment).

hasil_utama.value: Hypothetical, not measured: simulations suggest about 85% mapping accuracy and 70-80% less manual effort; the paper states there was no actual implementation or empirical evaluation.
hasil_utama.alasan: LLM menyajikan angka simulasi sebagai hasil.

subdomain_kesehatan.value: N/A (not healthcare-specific): evaluated on insurance claim and customer-support documents; healthcare is mentioned only as a possible future domain.

strategi_chunking.value: N/A - survey paper; reviews retrieval strategies but does not implement a chunking pipeline.

evaluasi_faithfulness.value: N/A - survey paper; reviews factual-consistency metrics (F1-CheXbert, F1-RadGraph, RAG-Check) rather than evaluating its own system.
